summary: Bundle bndl-644137520589f844 (Northside Clinic, 2026-11-10 06:16-15:16Z). Supported findings: (1) data staging: a full patients_full export was written by the jpark account to a hidden temp file /tmp/.font-unix/idx-3e08.bin at ~11:15:15Z, about 20.6 MB (shell history and fs_stat, host-local). (2) policy-violating transfer: at 11:18:27-11:18:40Z the staged file was uploaded via curl to 10.20.9.87:8080; the independent tap flow records 20,582,305 bytes out. That destination is not an approved bulk destination and the volume is far above the 5 MB threshold. Attribution: the jpark account was used; the human operator is not established. Shared console credentials have been found written down before, and badge data does not cover remote or tailgated sessions. Not supported: the local log removal claim. The collector holds a jpark login line at 11:14:18Z that the workstation auth.log lacks, but the gap is not tied to any removal action, so it is downgraded to an unexplained gap.
